dedupe_keys.name: on the impact of the antenna radiation patterns in passive radio sensing dataset

description: National Research Council researchers publish received-power measurements for passive radio sensing with directional and omnidirectional antennas. The May 2024 Zenodo release provides five CSV files and a MATLAB radio-map example under CC BY 4.0, free to download. Measurements cover seventy-five target positions in a 6.15-by-14.45-metre hall with a 3.35-metre ceiling. Transmitter and receiver are four metres apart at 0.99-metre height. Each antenna configuration has 401-frequency power observations in dBm and separate before/after free-space reference measurements. These data can calibrate indoor propagation and sensing models for network simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the dataset. The public text inconsistently gives 1.25 and 1.2 MHz frequency spacing, and repeats main filenames when describing reference files; the actual inventory distinguishes the latter with an fs suffix. Target coordinates require the cited paper. Acquisition dates, calibration uncertainty and array contents were not independently checked.
